summary: Implemented ReadOnlyView for MeteredWindowStore with proper serde application and metric recording. Added `readOnly(IsolationLevel)` method that returns a custom ReadOnlyMeteredWindowStore inner class wrapping the inner store's readonly view. The implementation applies serdes to deserialize keys and values, and records metrics for all fetch operations using existing sensors and iterator tracking. All 43 tests pass including 12 new readOnly-specific tests.
